# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- When a trip finishes, the user wants history to be persisted and reflected immediately (update on state change from 'Ocupado' to a non-occupied state). The project uses a history record to close trips when the vehicle leaves the 'Ocupado' state, and the user wants that reflected immediately.
- The user wants the history UI and memory display to show vehicle identifiers instead of history GUIDs.
